items.title: This little girl got measles at five months old. She died from it 10 years later
items.description: Measles killed Rebecca Archer's daughter Renae slowly and silently over a decade. She has a message for the growing number of parents hesitant to have their children vaccinated.

items.title: Trump battles historians for ownership of US presidential records
items.description: The Trump administration is pushing for a return to pre-Nixon days when US presidents could do whatever they wanted with presidential records.

items.title: Debunking Australian weather's made-up terms and pseudo-science
items.description: Meteorologic rhetoric in Australia, including from the media, can at times be inaccurate, misconstrued or just completely fictitious.

items.title: Will Australia be taken for a ride in the AI and data centre boom?
items.description: More than $150 billion is lined up for data centre development and investment in Australia, but there are questions as to whether the boom will provide benefits beyond a short-term construction boost.

items.title: Tasmania's police minister apologises for naming Port Arthur gunman
items.description: Felix Ellis has apologised for comments he made during budget estimates about the 1996 Port Arthur massacre in which he named the gunman, with one survivor labelling his comments "hurtful" and "disrespectful".

items.title: Psychologist sounds alarm over looksmaxxing and 'out-mogging'
items.description: While it's a bit of fun for some, the social media trend known as looksmaxxing can have major impacts on young men's physical and mental health.

items.title: Live: Yengi scores on debut as Socceroos draw with Switzerland in WC warm-up
items.description: The Socceroos respond after a poor first half to claim a 1-1 draw against Switzerland in their final match before the FIFA World Cup. Follow live.

items.title: Diver dies after being bitten by 4.5m shark off Albany, WA
items.description: A male diver has died after an attack by a suspected 4.5-metre shark near Michaelmas Island, off WA's Albany coast, on Saturday morning.

items.title: Struggling and desperate single mum saved by an 'employment mentor'
items.description: Personalised support helped domestic violence survivor and single mother Harsimran get a job, despite significant barriers. It's an approach that could benefit more jobseekers following the federal government's revamp of Workforce Australia.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' political movement spills onto Delhi's streets
items.description: India's largest online youth movement has taken to the streets for the first time, calling for the resignation of the education minister.

items.title: Ukraine renews attacks on St Petersburg after Putin rejects Zelenskyy meeting
items.description: A large-scale Ukrainian drone attack targets St Petersburg, with Russia intercepting 376 drones.

items.title: 'It's not normal to be winning the way I'm winning': Johnson excelling in open water
items.description: Moesha Johnson is enjoying an overseas open water swimming adventure that has seen her win gold at every stage. But these are all just stepping stones for the biggest prize of all at the Los Angeles Olympics in 2028.

items.title: Mexico score late winner against sloppy Matildas
items.description: The lacklustre Matildas have been beaten by Mexico for the first time in over 20 years, losing 1-0 in Newcastle.

items.title: Pope competes with Bad Bunny in Spain, urges leaders to reject polarisation
items.description: Pope Leo urges global leaders not to "fan the flames of polarisation" to gain popularity, warning of the artificial environment created by new technologies.

items.title: Planning, packing and nerves: Six Aussies kick off Race Around The World
items.description: Six Australian filmmakers are about to embark on the journey of a lifetime on Race Around The World. Here's how they're preparing for the unknown.

items.title: At Melbourne's last video rental store, physical media never died
items.description: CDs, DVDs, Blue-Rays and even VHS cassettes are enjoying a resurgence. Why some are returning to physical media?

items.title: Get a buzz out of spelling? It's time to show off your skills
items.description: Admit it, you can't get enough of my synonyms and similes. Let's get spelling!

items.title: 'We were so close': Laos cave rescue called off as conditions deteriorate
items.description: The search for two men trapped in a flooded cave in Laos has been postponed as rescuers say a "miracle" is needed.

items.title: Shots fired where gangster's funeral was advertised to be held
items.description: The ABC understands the funeral of Sydney gangster Lorenzo Lemalu was originally scheduled to take place at the venue in Punchbowl, but the plans were changed.

items.title: Father of infant boy charged with grievous bodily harm
items.description: A man is charged after his nine-week-old baby was taken to hospital with life-threatening injuries in April.

items.title: 'Let's talk about death': Breaking taboo over coffee and cake
items.description: The Death Cafe concept began in Switzerland in the 2000s to help people "make the most of our finite lives". Now, the concept has spread globally.

items.title: Andrew Moloney claims world title two years after quitting in anger
items.description: Andrew Moloney weathered champion Willibaldo Garcia's best over 12 brutal rounds to win a majority decision in their super flyweight world title clash in Japan.

items.title: Power hang on for thrilling win over Eagles, Dockers claim record win
items.description: Port Adelaide hangs on for a thrilling win over West Coast after Logan Morris kicked seven in a Brisbane QClash win and Fremantle beat North Melbourne by 124 points to claim the biggest win in its history.

items.title: 'We want trophies': The Diamonds coach embracing pressure in pursuit of history
items.description: The world has never been closer to Australia's Diamonds. Coach Stacey Marinkovich is determined to keep them shining brightest.

items.title: Broncos' season in crisis as Titans young gun conjures golden moment
items.description: Keano Kini scores one of the great game-winning tries to condemn Brisbane to a fifth-straight defeat, with the Titans snatching a 28-23 victory at Lang Park.
